notes.title: Online Multiplayer - Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34962723/1e26c842028e204a1148671fe708252b92b03c34.png[/img]

Get online and take on the world in Boxing Champs! play against random opponents or play against your steam friends in Boxing Champs with the new online multiplayer!

notes.title: Online multiplayer coming soon to Boxing Champs!
notes.content: We are working on integrating steamworks to include achievements and online multiplayer!

notes.title: Control Scheme
notes.content:
Includes full punch control using the twin sticks, and also have added keyboard control which you can customize yourself in game.
